tool.name: Wire saw
tool.desc: This saw uses a wire for mechanical cutting of solid bulk material such as stone, wood, glass, concrete, metals, etc. Perfect for improving your efficiency in the workshop.

tool.name: Shell snatcher
tool.desc: The perfect tool for snatching shells. It vibrates when shells are nearby.

tool.name: Small sack
tool.desc: A small jute sack you can carry with you that can hold an extra item.

tool.desc: A wrench adorned with the Adventurers' Guild insignia. Useful for making repairs and adjustments in the field.

tool.name: Screwdriver
tool.desc: Which way to rotate to tighten the screw? I always forget.

tool.name: Slipstick
tool.desc: A sophisticated mechanical calculator that provides functionality to make complex calculations that aid you in developing your creations.

tool.name: Big basket
tool.desc: Beautifully crafted from wicker. Can hold all your foraging finds with ease.

tool.name: Gem tipped tweezers
tool.desc: A set of tweezers reinforced with little bits of gems.

tool.name: Magnifying lens
tool.desc: A tool of master crafters who seek to unlock the secrets of complex machinery and study the world at a microscopic level.

tool.name: Bamboo toolbox
tool.desc: A strong toolbox for artisan tools, it can make carrying them around much easier.

tool.name: Spectral wrench
tool.desc: The ectoplasm jaws of this wrench always seem to have a perfect grip on whatever you apply them to. Kinda spooky.

tool.name: Mangrove basket
tool.desc: The mangrove basket was built from two different baskets, but the mangrove planks hide the seams flawlessly.

pet.name: Camel
pet.desc: A sturdy camel, perfect for desert travels.
pet.rareDesc: Regular camels come with just a hump, but what a rare treat! This camel has <c>twice as many</c>!

egg.name: Camel egg
egg.desc: The egg left behind by a camel, you can tell because it has a hump on it. That's how you tell, right?

pet.name: Golden Frog
pet.desc: A frog of golden colour that some say they will bring you good luck! Others say they taste great. Yeah, they don't like those other people.
pet.rareDesc: Make new friends, but keep the old. One is silver and the other is gold. So with these frogs you don't need to have other friends.

egg.name: Golden frog egg
egg.desc: The golden egg of a golden frog. It sure looks deceiving with its colour, you'd think it'd be hard and heavy, but it is quite light and squishy!

pet.name: Pet Rock
pet.desc: It's a rock. You feeling alright? Gonna talk to it? Have fun.
pet.rareDesc: It is <c>pet rocks all the way down</c>. Maybe you're even a pet rock.

egg.name: Pet rock egg
egg.desc: A pet rock egg? Is this a joke? You think something is going to come out of this? It is just a bunch of rocks clumped together.

pet.name: Pixie
pet.desc: A hyped up pixie, or is it a fairy? Quite ready for the party of a lifetime. You better be ready for anything.
pet.rareDesc: There's a saying that if you run across a party pixie, you better plan to not do anything the next day. Will you survive?

egg.name: Pixie egg
egg.desc: A pixie egg. Don't shake it at all or jolt it around! That goes without saying normally, but these cause problems for everyone around when that happens.

pet.name: Reindeer
pet.desc: A cheerful reindeer, can prance through snowy places with ease and still have energy to spare.
pet.rareDesc: This reindeer is showing some spirit and is extra <c>festive</c>! It looks like it could fly, but you probably shouldn't test it.

egg.name: Reindeer egg
egg.desc: A reindeer's egg. Should get this warmed up more even though the fur coating helps keep it a little warmer.

pet.name: Tortoise
pet.desc: A reserved tortoise, just holding steady. Slowly, but steadily.
pet.rareDesc: The shell of this tortoise has the shine of <c>precious metals in the shape of a flower</c>!

egg.name: Tortoise egg
egg.desc: A tortoise egg. It has an extra hard shell to it. Guess it will never be without one.

consumable.name: Nut mix
consumable.desc: Various nuts in a mix that give a good boost of protein with enjoyable flavor all together. Allergies pending.

consumable.name: Cooked perch
consumable.desc: Pan-fried or grilled, cooked perch offers a delightful flakiness and a mild, slightly sweet taste. Perfect for a light meal.

consumable.name: Beer
consumable.desc: Fermentation may have been a greater discovery than fire.

consumable.name: Roasted bell pepper
consumable.desc: Charred and seasoned peppers, bursting with smoky flavor.

consumable.name: Sweet carrot pie
consumable.desc: Carrots in a pie, oh my!
